summary: First test iteration for MamieSafe. Backend: 16/16 pytest tests passed against public URL (config GET/PUT+persistence, events create + newest-first ordering for bedtime/checkin/sos/fall, alerts create/list/validate/dismiss/404, location post + latest, heartbeat + status, dashboard summary aggregation). Frontend: forced onboarding tutorial works (5 taps reach Mamie home), bedtime button creates event + shows 'Bonne nuit' toast, SOS opens countdown overlay with working cancel-emergency-button, PIN 1234 unlocks to dashboard, all 4 tabs render (Statut with status-card+vitals grid, Alertes list, Carte with Leaflet map + marker, Réglages), settings save adds contact and shows 'Réglages enregistrés ✓' toast confirming PUT /api/config persistence. No blocking issues found. Only cosmetic RN web console warnings (expected on web).

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Cosmetic - originates from a third-party lib (likely reanimated/expo-router). Reference: browser console at /mamie and /dashboard/settings
Console warning: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow"'. Cosmetic - originates from react-leaflet/map lib. Reference: /dashboard/map

action_items: (Optional, non-blocking) Track down source of 'props.pointerEvents' and 'shadow*' deprecation warnings and migrate when upstream libs upgrade. No action required now.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py cleanly excludes MongoDB _id in all responses (good).
All backend routes are correctly prefixed with /api via APIRouter (good).
Frontend uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL via src/config -> API_BASE (good, no hardcoded URLs).

All interactive elements expose testID attributes (onboarding-next-button, mamie-bedtime-button, mamie-sos-button, cancel-emergency-button, pin-1..pin-4, status-card, input-*, sensitivity-*, interval-*, contact-add, settings-save) — excellent test coverage support.
Bedtime countdown effect uses functional setState with dependency on `pending` and clears timeout properly.
PATCH /alerts/{id} correctly returns 404 for unknown IDs.
Heartbeat model always overrides updated_at on POST — good.
Consider adding backend validation that dashboard_pin is 4 digits (currently accepts any string) — low priority.
seed_data_creation: Test run created (and left) sample events (bedtime/checkin/sos/fall), 2 alerts (1 validated, 1 dismissed), 1 location point at Paris (48.8566, 2.3522), a heartbeat doc, and 1 contact 'TEST_Contact/0611223344' in config. Config restored to friendly defaults (Mamie / moyenne / 4h) at end of test_put_config_persists.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All flows listed in the review request are green. Backend tests are in /app/backend/tests/test_mamiesafe_api.py and can be re-run with: EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL=https://grand-secure.preview.emergentagent.com pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v. Native-only features (accelerometer fall detection, continuous voice, tel: auto-dial, push notifications) are correctly gated with Platform.OS !== 'web' and were not tested — expected. Mamie header correctly reads 'Protection active' on web (voice unsupported in headless Chromium).
